opportunities.title: IAHS SYSTA – Sivapalan Young Scientists Travel Awards (e.g. for IUGG 2027 Incheon)
opportunities.place: IAHS events worldwide (e.g. IUGG General Assembly, Incheon, Korea, 16-22 Jul 2027)
opportunities.feeText: Free to apply; registration fee paid by IAHS for awardees
opportunities.deadlineText: Rolling: apply as early as possible and at least 6 months before the event (a fixed deadline in IAHS eNews takes precedence). For IUGG 2027 (16 Jul 2027) that means by mid-Jan 2027.
opportunities.when: Travel to a single IAHS event (meeting length)

lines: Level: Registered PhD students, or PhD completed less than 5 years ago (+1 year per child for parental leave)
Nationality/residency: Must have grown up in and currently reside in a 'financially disadvantaged country' (60% lowest GDP per capita); Lebanon IS on the IAHS list
Age: Not stated (no age limit stated)
Other: First author of an English paper in Hydrological Sciences Journal, PIAHS or another listed hydrology journal; must present at the meeting; no previous SYSTA for intercontinental travel

money: Transport covered; IAHS books flights through its travel agent (within cap)
Covered; arranged by IAHS travel agent (within cap)
Paid by IAHS directly to the organisers
steps: Read the IAHS guidance on completing the SYSTA application form.
Fill in the SYSTA application form (PDF on the official page), in English.
Email the form plus a copy of your first-author paper to IAHS at least 6 months before the event.
Decision and award amount are emailed within about 6 weeks.
opportunities.caveat: Only for hydrology PhD students/early-career researchers who already have a first-author paper in a listed journal. The SYSTA page does not name IUGG 2027 specifically; IUGG 2027 dates come from the official IUGG 2027 site (iugg2027korea.org, abstract/travel-grant submission 30 Oct 2026 - 16 Feb 2027). About 11-12 awards per year.
opportunities.desc: Travel awards that help young hydrology scientists pay to attend the IUGG 2027 conference in Incheon.
opportunities.skillsNote: PhD student or recent PhD graduate in hydrology

opportunities.place: Kfardebian (Faraya), Keserwan – 46 km from Beirut, Lebanon
opportunities.deadlineText: Seasonal – winter (rolling); 2026-27 opening date not announced yet
opportunities.when: Ski season (usually early December to early April; the resort says December through April). Hours: 08:00–16:00 (limited opening times on weekdays) per skiresort.inf. 2026-27 opening date: not announced yet (snow dependent). Altitude 1,850–2,465 m (summit Mzaar 2,465 m). 42 slopes, about 80 km of pistes (the official site also says 80+ / 100+ km). skiresort.info splits 40 km as easy 9 km, intermediate 16 km, difficult 15 km. SkiLeb lists 19 lifts in 3 sectors – Jonction/Domaine du Soleil (10), Wardeh (7), Refuge (2) – graded 5 beginner, 8 medium, 6 advanced. Snowshoeing, ski touring, skidoo and zipline also offered.
